Shadi-vivah vali khajur tamatar ki khatti-mithi chatni ab ghar par rojana khane men banayen. Authentic Bengali-Style Khajur Tamatar Ki Chutney chatni tamatar, khajur, gur, kaju, kishmish aur deshi masalon se banaee jati hai. dal bhari radhavallabhi puri ke sath, kachauri,parathe ya kisi bhi khas thali ke sath parosen. apne rojana ke khane ya khas avasron ka svad doguna karne ke lie yah resipi zarur traee karen.
Ingredients for Dates Tomato Chutney
Tamatar - Tomato - 4 no. (300g)
Khajur - Dates - 5 no.
Tel - Oil - 1 tbsp
Jira - Cumin seeds - ¼ tsp
Saunph - Fennel seeds - ¼ tsp
